text: The project is named '心衰大模型项目组' and focuses on heart failure management.
The project aims to develop a standardized AI tool for grassroots medical institutions to improve heart failure treatment.
The project will utilize a model based on '病因分析-劢态管理-用药安全' for precise capacity management and multidimensional drug intervention.
The project aims to reduce patient readmission rates and adverse drug reactions, thereby alleviating the medical burden.

The project is supported by policies and technological advancements in AI healthcare.
The project aims to address the clinical management pain points in heart failure treatment, including high readmission rates and diagnostic challenges.
The project will involve collaboration with 16 hospitals, including 安徽省胸科医院.
The project targets over 12 million heart failure patients in China who do not receive standardized treatment.
The annual healthcare cost for heart failure in the U.S. is approximately $300 billion.
The prevalence of heart failure in developed countries is higher, with rates of 2.45% in the U.S. and 1.5%-2% in Europe.
In China, the annual healthcare cost for heart failure is estimated at 400 billion yuan.
